alt: Numbers are read one at a time. Each one that is not the sentinel joins a running total, shown above the array; the sentinel itself is marked as invalid and stops the loop before it is added. One preset sums two numbers before the sentinel; the other hits the sentinel on the very first number, leaving the total at zero.

steps.caption: Read the first number before the loop starts. It is 4.
4 joins the running total since it is not the sentinel. The total becomes 4, and the next read is 6.
6 behaves the same way (it is not the sentinel); the total now stands at 10, ready for the next read, 0.
Then 0 shows up. That is the sentinel, so the loop ends before total += number runs.
